metadata.title: Characteristics of the two sequences seen in the high-velocity Hertzsprung-Russell diagram in Gaia DR2

notes: No eligible stars. The paper analyzes statistical samples and populations rather than individually identified Galactic unbound candidates. Its V_T > 200 km/s threshold (T:p2-b9) defines high-velocity/halo stars but is not an explicit Galactic-unbound criterion, and the blue/red sequences are interpreted as accreted-halo and thick-disk populations.
